parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowed: id, seller_sku, asin1, item_name, price, quantity, status, fulfillment_channel, brand, product_type, created_at, updated_at. Prefix with `-` for descending. Default: -id.

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: 0 = active (default), 1 (or `true`) = archived only, `only` = archived only, `all` = include both.
